# platform-binpath-baseline — hardcoded macOS command-binary path
# literals (/usr/sbin/chown, /usr/sbin/lsof) per file under
# packages/admin/evolve_admin. Generated by `tools/platform-path-lint
# --rule binpath --all --update-baseline`. chown/lsof live at a different
# absolute path on Linux (/usr/bin/...), and the daemon's sudo NOPASSWD
# grant is rendered with the platform-correct binary — so a hardcoded
# macOS path makes sudo prompt (no TTY) and the op fails silently. Route
# it through platform_profile.get_profile().chown / .lsof. The lint blocks
# any file that EXCEEDS its count, so this file may only ratchet DOWN.
# Goal state: empty.
